# Lasse Ruttert > Lasse Ruttert is a graduate research assistant and M.Sc. Computer Science student at the University of Bonn, working on AI safety, reinforcement learning, NLP and LLM agents. This is the personal site of Lasse Ruttert: research, publications, projects and a blog. ## Pages - [About](https://lasseruttert.github.io/): an introduction and research interests - [Experience](https://lasseruttert.github.io/experience/): research positions and degrees - [Publications](https://lasseruttert.github.io/publications/): papers - [Projects](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/): research code, benchmarks and experiments - [Blog](https://lasseruttert.github.io/blog/) ## Experience - Graduate Research Assistant, The University of Bonn (Nov 2026 – Present) - Volunteer Research Assistant, The University of Bonn (Apr 2026 – Oct 2026) - Student Research Assistant, Fraunhofer FKIE (Apr 2025 – Oct 2026) - Bachelor Thesis, Fraunhofer FKIE (Oct 2025 – Mar 2026) ## Education - Master, Computer Science, The University of Bonn (Apr 2026 – Present) - Bachelor of Science, Computer Science, The University of Bonn (Oct 2022 – Mar 2026) ## Publications - [The Overfitters at Touché: Joint Causality Extraction with DeBERTa-v3](https://lasseruttert.github.io/publications/clef-2026-touche/): Lasse Ruttert and others. CLEF 2026 Working Notes, Sep 24, 2026. - [Reinforcement Learning Can Amplify Emergent Misalignment from Harmless Rewards](https://lasseruttert.github.io/publications/emnlp-2026-emergent-misalignment/): Lasse Ruttert and others. EMNLP 2026, Main Conference, May 29, 2026. ## Projects - [PDPBench: Google DeepMind, Measuring Progress Toward AGI](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/PDPBench/): A benchmark for frontier LLMs, in which they solve incrementally harder parts of Pickup and Delivery Problems with Time Windows. Part of the Google DeepMind Measuring Progress Toward AGI competition, Executive Functions track. - [CLEF 2026: Touché](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/clef_2026_touche/): Trained a joint DeBERTa-v3 encoder with task-specific heads to detect causal news sentences, extract the spans in the causal relationship, and classify span pairs as causal, countercausal, or uncausal. - [SemEval 2026: Task 11](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/semeval_2026_task11/): A two-stage pipeline: an LLM abstracts premises and conclusions into domain-independent logical forms, then the logical validity of the normalized form is classified. Built as part of an NLP course at the University of Bonn. - [Kaggle Competitions](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/kaggle/): NLP competitions on Kaggle for hands-on experience with BERT fine-tuning, LLM fine-tuning, and reward modelling. - [RL Memetic PDPTW](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/rl-memetic-pdptw/): Bachelor thesis: RL picks the local-search operators of a memetic algorithm. - [GED on Molecular Graphs](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/ged_on_molecular_graphs/): Graph Edit Distance on molecular graphs. - [TensorTonic Solutions](https://lasseruttert.github.io/projects/TensorTonic-Solutions/): Solutions to TensorTonic problems. ## Elsewhere - GitHub: https://github.com/lasseruttert - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lasse-ruttert
